verdicts.reason: A is broken. The text block sits off-centre and spills past the right edge of the label frame. Decorative rules are scattered: one crosses the frame, and stray dashes float at x≈75 and x≈320. The illustrations collide with the frame and are spread unevenly with a dead gap in the middle, so the label reads as a wreck. B is better because the label is centred with its text inside it. Its flaws: the divider rules sit orphaned in the top-right corner, and fragments (a soap bar, the bowl) are scattered. Several illustrations overlap the bottom of the label. The text is small for the banner height, so it still needs real fixes.
